verses.text: Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
lines: Yahweh reigns!
Let the earth rejoice!
Let the multitude of islands be glad!

verses.text: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
lines: Clouds and darkness are around him.
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

verses.text: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
lines: A fire goes before him,
and burns up his adversaries on every side.

verses.text: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
lines: His lightning lights up the world.
The earth sees, and trembles.

verses.text: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
lines: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh,
at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

verses.text: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
lines: The heavens declare his righteousness.
All the peoples have seen his glory.

verses.text: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
lines: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images,
who boast in their idols.
Worship him, all you gods!

verses.text: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, Yahweh.
lines: Zion heard and was glad.
The daughters of Judah rejoiced
because of your judgments, Yahweh.

verses.text: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
lines: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth.
You are exalted far above all gods.

verses.text: You who love Yahweh, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
lines: You who love Yahweh, hate evil!
He preserves the souls of his saints.
He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.text: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
lines: Light is sown for the righteous,
and gladness for the upright in heart.

verses.text: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
lines: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people!
Give thanks to his holy Name.
